import pandas as pd
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score, train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

churn = pd.read_csv("churn_export_january.csv")
churn["lifetime_orders"] = churn["orders"] + churn["orders_oct_to_dec"]
X = churn.drop(columns=["customer_id", "churned", "country", "segment", "orders_oct_to_dec"])
X = SimpleImputer(strategy="median").fit_transform(X)
y = churn["churned"]
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)
model = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression())
print(cross_val_score(model, X_train, y_train, cv=5, scoring="roc_auc").mean())
